acquisition.purpose: Read-only acquisition of the unchanged A19 actual barrel choices and public combat inputs on ALL3024 already-opened stock cases. Zero new independent strength games, candidate, learner, action/RNG/search change or efficacy/cost claim. Do not confuse teacher agreement with match strength.
acquisition.preflightSelection: Allfour cases from the earliest family of each of the four fixed opponent styles. No outcome/runtime selection. Require every original full input/action/event trace/outcome control and at least one eligible root observation before collection.
acquisition.outputs: Gzip public-state observations only at the frozen intent-model eligibility boundary, joined to ACTUAL committed stock turn choices. Preserve third-choice actions and array-identity metadata. Always return the exact original cleanup array. Case outcomes are controls, not labels. Seeds/UUIDs/case/host/registration identities must remain metadata and cannot be learner inputs.
acquisition.nextBoundary: No fitting or fresh bank allocation from this controller. Independent data/label/input/trace verification and cold observation parity are required before a separately registered fitter or policy. Future evaluation must use the then-current adopted default, include full gain/loss checks and new independent channels within overall-average +10%.
acquisition.knownLimitations: Reused v10 teacher data retain its native policy and array-identity memory behavior. Not the current v11 independent confirmation, not production clock qualification, not native v0.9 training. All previous seed exclusions remain unchanged.

validation.scope: All 3024 unchanged acquisition games and all observations. Independently recompute public-actor/actions/labels, every original trace/input/outcome, source hashes and sixteen fixed preflight-vs-collection fresh-process cold repeats.
validation.producerLabelPayloadHashes: Independently reserialized with Bun; Python checks raw compressed bytes and parsed values without changing tiny-number spelling.
validation.notAnExperiment: No policy, new games, learner, architecture selection, strength gain, timing gain or serving change.
validation.failure: Preserve all records; no automatic retries, acquisition restarts, fitting or deployment.

fit.purpose: Develop a cheap original-A19 choice predictor at the eligible barrel boundary. Preserve all third actions, helpful clears and old failed studies. No serving or new strength study.
fit.admission: All 3024 original reused v10 stock games, independent Python/Bun source/input/full-trace/outcome/label validation and exact sixteen-case fresh-process observation parity must pass before feature encoding or fitting.
fit.inputs: 110 explicit public combat statistics/geometry/action-intent features. UUIDs used only to join public actor and initiative queue. No seed, outcome, actual chosen action, label, case/family/host/registration identity enters X. Metamorphic label/identifier checks on first64 observations.
fit.geometry: This immutable acquisition uses source-default sixteen-square grid, cell world size128/maxWorldX1024. Future runtime adapter must derive geometry from context, not assume these dimensions.
fit.folds: SHA256(native-barrel-teacher-family-fold-v1/<board>), first big-endian32 modulo10;0..5train,6..7validation,8..9test. Whole four-case family together; identity is split metadata only.
labels: any other committed action, including a different clear path
fit.semanticClearControl: Retain separately whether the actual chosen action hits the native barrel target, including different clear paths; use all of those as true clears for false-rejection diagnostics.
fit.recipe: Float64 standardized/clipped-eight linear three-class softmax; fixed400 full-batch Adam steps,lr0.025,beta1.9,beta2.999,epsilon1e-8. L2 in[.0001,.001,.01,.1], intercept unpenalized. Pick minimum validation logloss, ties favor larger L2. Refit train+validation once, write final artifact before opening test file. No repeated tuning or replacement after test.
fit.gateProposal: Predict pre-cleanup intent only at P(before)>=.85 and unique/argmax before; otherwise retain native forecast. Proposal remains inactive.

bootstrap.interpretation: Internal held-out teacher-choice prediction only; zero independent strength games.

fit.nextBoundary: Even a passed teacher development fit needs a separately registered alias-contract/input/full gain-loss admission, hypothetical-state distribution checks, fresh then-current-v12 strength and overall-average +10% cost. No automatic new bank allocation or default changes.
fit.termination: One frozen fit recipe. Preserve all failed results and partial artifacts; no retries, test re-use for tuning, policy evaluation or deployment from this supervisor.

limitations: Reused v10 teacher choices, not current-v12 qualification or counterfactual optimal actions.
Identifiers and seeds are join metadata only; future fitting needs independent family folds and a separate prospective registration.
Non-barrel choices can be a third action, not the pre-cleanup proposal. Keep those labels and abstention cases.

fitAnalysis.nextBoundary: Only if these development gates pass, separately register a policy/input/alias-contract admission and fresh then-current-v12 strength and overall-average +10% cost. No auto-promotion.
limitations: Teacher choices are not counterfactual best actions or battle outcomes.
Same reused v10 acquisition, family-disjoint internal test only.
Actual root-state training may shift under hypothetical rollout states; test that separately.

thirdActionTaxonomy.interpretation: Full opened reused teacher data, descriptive only. A third action means not exactly either proposal; same move endpoint does not establish same path/hazards/actions. These categories do not prove a better learned policy or causal battle outcome, and must not retune the closed held-out fit.

from pathlib import Path
import concurrent.futures
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import queue
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time

import shutil
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
stage=sys.argv[1];assert stage in ['preflight','collection']
host='puffalo-stock-v10-teacher'
raw=(p/'barrel-teacher-registration.json').read_bytes();reg=json.loads(raw);seal=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
assert hashlib.sha256((p/'strength-registration.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==reg['sourceManifestSha256']
for row in [*json.loads((p/'strength-registration.json').read_text())['files'],*reg['files']]:
 assert hashlib.sha256((p/row['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==row['sha256'],row['path']
assert subprocess.check_output(['bun','--version'],text=True).strip()=='1.4.4'
if stage=='collection':
 prior=json.loads((p/'barrel-teacher-preflight/status.json').read_text())
 assert prior['complete']and not prior['errors']and not prior['liveWorkerPids']and prior['fights']==16 and prior['labels']>0
 assert prior['registrationSha256']==seal
workers=reg['workers'][stage];deadline=reg['deadlines'][stage]
jobs=json.loads((p/('barrel-teacher-preflight-cases.json'if stage=='preflight'else'barrel-teacher-cases.json')).read_text())
assert len(jobs)==(16 if stage=='preflight'else 3024)
assert shutil.disk_usage(p).free>=reg['minimumFreeBytes']
out = p / f'barrel-teacher-{stage}'
out.mkdir()
q = queue.Queue()
for job in jobs: q.put(job)
lock = threading.Lock()
stop = threading.Event()
processes = []
state = {'labels':0,'labelCounts':{'clear':0,'other':0},'complete': False, 'host': host, 'expectedCases': len(jobs), 'completedCases': 0, 'fights': 0, 'errors': []}
started = time.monotonic()

def status():
    payload = {**state, 'elapsedSeconds': round(time.monotonic() - started, 3),
        'controllerPid': os.getpid(), 'liveWorkerPids': [proc.pid for proc in processes if proc.poll() is None],
        'registrationSha256': seal, 'absoluteDeadlineEpoch': deadline}
    tmp = out / 'status.tmp'
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(payload) + '\n')
    tmp.replace(out / 'status.json')

def terminate_owned():
    stop.set()
    with lock:
        state['errors'].append('Common fixed execution deadline reached; no extension')
        for proc in processes:
            if proc.poll() is None: proc.terminate()

remaining = deadline - time.time()
assert remaining > 0, 'The registered common deadline is already past'
timer = threading.Timer(remaining, terminate_owned)
timer.daemon = True
timer.start()

def lane(i):
    with (out / f'worker-{i}.log').open('w') as log:
        proc = subprocess.Popen(['nice', '-n', '19', 'bun', '--preload', str(p/'alias.ts'), str(p/'barrel-teacher-actor.ts'), str(out/f'worker-{i}.jsonl.gz'), str(out/f'worker-{i}-labels.jsonl.gz')],
            cwd=p, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=log, text=True, bufsize=1,
            env={**os.environ, 'HOC_A19_CONTEXT_POLICY': 'on'})
        with lock: processes.append(proc)
        try:
            while not stop.is_set():
                assert time.time() < deadline
                try: job = q.get_nowait()
                except queue.Empty: break
                task = {**job, 'stage': 'teacher-'+stage, 'assignedHost': host}
                proc.stdin.write(json.dumps({'job': task, 'registrationSha256': seal}) + '\n')
                proc.stdin.flush()
                while True:
                    line = proc.stdout.readline()
                    if not line: raise RuntimeError(f'{host} worker{i} exited at {job["board"]}/{job["game"]}')
                    try: ack = json.loads(line)
                    except json.JSONDecodeError:
                        log.write(line); continue
                    if isinstance(ack, dict) and ack.get('verified'): break
                    log.write(line)
                assert (ack['board'], ack['game'], ack['rows']) == (job['board'], job['game'], 1)
                with lock:
                    state['completedCases'] += 1
                    state['fights'] += 1
                    state['labels'] += ack['labels']
                    for kind in ['clear','other']:state['labelCounts'][kind]+=ack['labelCounts'][kind]
            proc.stdin.close()
            assert proc.wait() == 0
        except BaseException as error:
            stop.set()
            with lock: state['errors'].append(str(error))
            raise
        finally:
            if proc.poll() is None: proc.terminate(); proc.wait()

try:
    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=workers) as pool:
        futures = [pool.submit(lane, i) for i in range(workers)]
        while not all(f.done() for f in futures):
            if not stop.is_set()and(shutil.disk_usage(p).free<reg['minimumFreeBytes']or sum(f.stat().st_size for f in out.glob('*.gz'))>reg['maximumStageCompressedBytes']):
                stop.set()
                with lock:state['errors'].append('Fixed disk floor or byte ceiling reached; preserve all records, no retry')
                for proc in processes:
                    if proc.poll()is None:proc.terminate()
            with lock: status()
            print(json.dumps({**state, 'elapsedSeconds': round(time.monotonic() - started, 2)}), flush=True)
            time.sleep(5)
        for future in futures: future.result()
    assert not state['errors'] and state['completedCases'] == len(jobs)
    assert state['labels']>0,'Fixed observation coverage failed; no collection/fitter promotion'
    state['complete'] = True
finally:
    timer.cancel()
    with lock: status()
    print(json.dumps({**state, 'elapsedSeconds': round(time.monotonic() - started, 2)}), flush=True)

seal='44d2366afc1bbca1f079b474b22659c716b67b1bb7c79beb646df7bca447d424'

 assert hashlib.sha256((data/f['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==f['sha256'],f['path']

def stage(name):
 root=data/('barrel-teacher-'+name);status=json.loads((root/'status.json').read_text())
 assert status['complete']and not status['errors']and not status['liveWorkerPids']and status['registrationSha256']==seal
 cases=json.loads((data/('barrel-teacher-preflight-cases.json'if name=='preflight'else'barrel-teacher-cases.json')).read_text())
 expected={(c['board'],c['game']):c for c in cases};assert len(expected)==len(cases)==status['fights']
 controls={};labels=collections.defaultdict(list);inventory=[]
 for file in sorted(root.glob('worker-*.jsonl.gz')):
  raw=file.read_bytes();inventory.append({'path':str(file.relative_to(data)),'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()})
  for line in gzip.decompress(raw).splitlines():
   r=json.loads(line);key=(r['board'],r['game']);assert key in expected
   assert r['registrationSha256']==seal
   if '-labels.'in file.name:labels[key].append(r)
   else:
    assert key not in controls;controls[key]=r;c=expected[key]
    assert r['inputSha256']==c['expectedInputSha256']and r['traceSha256']==c['expectedTraceSha256']and r['score']==c['expectedScore']
    assert r['pureStockOriginalControlPassed']and r['quality']['rejected']==0
    assert all(r['quality']['searchUses'][str(t)]>0 for t in [1,2])
    for n in r['quality']['neural']:
     for field in ['modelErrors','missingStart','deadlineAbstentions','inferenceOverruns']:assert n[field]==0
    for w in r['quality']['work']:
     for field in ['deadlineFallbacks','degradedDecisions','circuitSkipped','circuitWaitArbitrations']:assert w[field]==0
 assert set(controls)==set(expected)
 ids=set();counts=collections.Counter({'clear':0,'other':0});alternatives=collections.Counter({'cleanup':0,'before':0,'third_action':0});observed_families=set()
 for key,control in controls.items():
  group=sorted(labels[key],key=lambda r:r['ordinal']);assert len(group)==control['labels']
  call=collections.Counter();local=collections.Counter()
  for ordinal,r in enumerate(group):
   assert r['ordinal']==ordinal and r['sourceProfile']=='v10'
   assert r['labelId']==f"{key[0]}/{key[1]}/{r['actualTurn']}/{r['rootCallOrdinal']}"and r['labelId']not in ids
   ids.add(r['labelId']);assert 0<=r['actualTurn']<control['actualTurns']
   assert r['rootCallOrdinal']==call[r['actualTurn']];call[r['actualTurn']]+=1
   assert r['inputSha256']==control['inputSha256']and r['traceSha256']==control['traceSha256']
   assert r['seed']==expected[key]['seed']
   units=r['publicState']['units'];assert len({u['id']for u in units})==len(units)
   actor=[u for u in units if u['id']==r['unitId']];assert len(actor)==1
   assert actor[0]['name']==r['actor']and actor[0]['team']==r['team']and not actor[0]['dead']
   strikes=[a for a in r['cleanup']if a['type']=='obstacle_attack'];assert len(strikes)==1
   strike=strikes[0];assert strike['attackerId']==r['unitId']
   chosen=any(a['type']=='obstacle_attack'and a['attackerId']==strike['attackerId']and a['targetPosition']==strike['targetPosition']for a in r['chosenDecision'])
   assert r['labelChoseNativeBarrel']==int(chosen)
   assert r['exactCleanupChosen']==(r['chosenDecision']==r['cleanup'])
   assert r['exactPreCleanupChosen']==(r['chosenDecision']==r['before'])
   assert type(r['rawAndChosenShareArray'])is bool
   if r['rawAndChosenShareArray']:assert r['actualRawIncumbent']==r['chosenDecision']
   counts['clear'if chosen else'other']+=1;local['clear'if chosen else'other']+=1
   alternatives['cleanup'if r['exactCleanupChosen']else'before'if r['exactPreCleanupChosen']else'third_action']+=1
   observed_families.add(r['board'])
  assert {k:local[k]for k in ['clear','other']}==control['labelCounts']
 assert len(ids)==status['labels']and {k:counts[k]for k in ['clear','other']}==status['labelCounts']
 return {'status':status,'controls':controls,'labels':labels,'inventory':inventory,'counts':dict(counts),
         'alternatives':dict(alternatives),'observedFamilies':len(observed_families),'ids':ids}

pre=stage('preflight');full=stage('collection');assert len(full['controls'])==3024 and len(pre['controls'])==16
repeated=0
for key,b in pre['controls'].items():
 a=full['controls'][key]
 for field in ['inputSha256','traceSha256','score','actualTurns','labels','labelCounts','labelsSha256']:assert a[field]==b[field],(key,field)
 aa=sorted(full['labels'][key],key=lambda r:r['ordinal']);bb=sorted(pre['labels'][key],key=lambda r:r['ordinal'])
 assert aa==bb,('cold observation mismatch',key);repeated+=len(aa)
assert repeated>0
result={'passed':True,'teacherRegistrationSha256':seal,'stockFights':len(full['controls']),
 'observations':len(full['ids']),'families':756,'familiesWithObservations':full['observedFamilies'],
 'labelCounts':full['counts'],'exactActionCategories':full['alternatives'],
 'allOriginalInputsFullTracesOutcomesExact':True,'allPublicActorAndLabelChecksPassed':True,
 'freshProcessColdCases':16,'exactRepeatedObservations':repeated,'coldObservationParity':True,
 'inventory':pre['inventory']+full['inventory'],
 'newIndependentStrengthSamples':0,'learnerFitted':False,'servingActivated':False,

import collections,hashlib,json,math,os,time

import numpy as np

def load(fold):
 rows=[json.loads(line)for line in(encoded/(fold+'.jsonl')).read_text().splitlines()]
 return rows,np.array([r['x']for r in rows],dtype=np.float64),np.array([r['y']for r in rows],dtype=np.int64)

assert len(set(y.tolist()))==3 and len(set(vy.tolist()))==3
def transform(x,mean,scale):return np.clip((x-mean)/scale,-8,8)
def probabilities(x,w,b):
 z=x@w+b;z-=z.max(axis=1,keepdims=True);e=np.exp(z);return e/e.sum(axis=1,keepdims=True)
def fit(x,y,penalty):
 mean=x.mean(axis=0);scale=x.std(axis=0);scale[scale<1e-8]=1
 z=transform(x,mean,scale);w=np.zeros((z.shape[1],3),dtype=np.float64)
 b=np.log((np.bincount(y,minlength=3)+1)/(len(y)+3));mw=np.zeros_like(w);vw=np.zeros_like(w);mb=np.zeros_like(b);vb=np.zeros_like(b)
 for step in range(1,401):
  error=probabilities(z,w,b);error[np.arange(len(y)),y]-=1;error/=len(y)
  dw=z.T@error+penalty*w;db=error.sum(axis=0)

  w-=.025*(mw/(1-.9**step))/(np.sqrt(vw/(1-.999**step))+1e-8)
  b-=.025*(mb/(1-.9**step))/(np.sqrt(vb/(1-.999**step))+1e-8)
 assert np.isfinite(w).all()and np.isfinite(b).all()
 return mean,scale,w,b
recipes=[]
for penalty in [.0001,.001,.01,.1]:
 mean,scale,w,b=fit(x,y,penalty);pred=probabilities(transform(vx,mean,scale),w,b)
 loss=float(-np.log(np.maximum(pred[np.arange(len(vy)),vy],1e-15)).mean())
 recipes.append({'l2':penalty,'validationLogLoss':loss})

all_x=np.concatenate([x,vx]);all_y=np.concatenate([y,vy]);mean,scale,w,b=fit(all_x,all_y,selected['l2'])
prior=(np.bincount(all_y,minlength=3)+1)/(len(all_y)+3)

 'schemaSha256':hashlib.sha256((encoded/'schema.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'featureNames':schema['names'],
 'classes':['cleanup','before','third_action'],'mean':mean.tolist(),'scale':scale.tolist(),'weights':w.tolist(),'bias':b.tolist(),
 'standardizedClip':8,'beforeConfidence':.85,'selectedL2':selected['l2'],'epochs':400,'adamLearningRate':.025,
 'constantTrainingClassPrior':prior.tolist(),'testLabelsUsedForFitOrSelection':False,'servingActivated':False}
with(p/'model.json').open('x')as file:file.write(json.dumps(artifact,indent=2)+'\n')
model_sha=hashlib.sha256((p/'model.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
# This is the first access to the held-out observation/label file in the fitter.
test,tx,ty=load('test');test_families={r['family']for r in test}
assert test_families.isdisjoint(r['family']for r in train+validation)
assert len(set(ty.tolist()))==3
pred=probabilities(transform(tx,mean,scale),w,b);constant=np.tile(prior,(len(ty),1));selected_class=pred.argmax(axis=1)
semantic_clear=np.array([r['semanticClear']for r in test],dtype=bool)
before=(pred[:,1]>=.85)&(selected_class==1)
loss=-np.log(np.maximum(pred[np.arange(len(ty)),ty],1e-15));baseline_loss=-np.log(constant[np.arange(len(ty)),ty])
confusion=np.zeros((3,3),dtype=np.int64)
for truth,guess in zip(ty,selected_class):confusion[truth,guess]+=1
groups={}
for i,r in enumerate(test):
 a=groups.setdefault(r['family'],np.zeros(7,dtype=np.float64))
 a+=np.array([baseline_loss[i]-loss[i],1,int(before[i]and ty[i]==1),int(before[i]),int(before[i]and semantic_clear[i]),int(semantic_clear[i]),int(before[i])])
matrix=np.stack([groups[k]for k in sorted(groups)]);rng=np.random.default_rng(1746499311);boot=[]
for unused in range(5000):
 a=matrix[rng.integers(0,len(matrix),len(matrix))].sum(axis=0)
 boot.append([a[0]/max(1,a[1]),a[2]/max(1,a[3]),a[4]/max(1,a[5])])
ci=np.quantile(np.array(boot),[.025,.975],axis=0)
improvement=float((baseline_loss-loss).mean());correct=int(((ty==1)&before).sum());predicted=int(before.sum());true_clear=int(semantic_clear.sum());false_clear=int((semantic_clear&before).sum())
precision=correct/max(1,predicted);false_rate=false_clear/max(1,true_clear)
support_families=len({test[i]['family']for i in range(len(test))if before[i]})
gates={'logLossGainAtLeast002':improvement>=.02,'logLossFamily95LowerPositive':bool(ci[0,0]>0),
 'confidentBeforeAtLeast25':predicted>=25,'confidentBeforeFamiliesAtLeast10':support_families>=10,
 'confidentBeforePrecisionAtLeast085':precision>=.85,'confidentBeforePrecisionFamily95LowerAtLeast075':bool(ci[0,1]>=.75),
 'trueClearFalseBeforeRateAtMost005':false_rate<=.05}
predictions=[]
for i,r in enumerate(test):predictions.append({'family':r['family'],'labelId':r['labelId'],'truth':int(ty[i]),'probabilities':pred[i].tolist(),'confidentBefore':bool(before[i])})

   a['targetCells']=sorted(a.get('targetCells',[]),key=lambda c:(c['x'],c['y']))

 return result
